copy.hubIntro: Ku fahimci juna, ku koyi dalilin da dangantaka ke ƙarfi ko ta lalace, ku kuma gwada kyawawan hanyoyi, tare.
copy.englishNote: Halal Cards na Turanci ne a yanzu.
copy.labBlurb: Aiki ne da ke nuna yanayi na gaske. Ku zaɓa, ku ga abin da zai faru, sannan ku tattauna.
copy.labGate: Ƙananan bitoci huɗu kan dalilin da aure ke tafiya da kuma dalilin da yake fuskantar ƙalubale. Kowacce tana nuna yanayi na gaske: ku zaɓa a ɓoye, ku ga inda kowane zaɓi zai kai, sannan ku tattauna.
copy.quizzesBlurb: Ya fi sauƙi, ya fi sauri, kuma yana bayyana abubuwa. Ku amsa a ɓoye, sannan ku bayyana tare.
copy.quizzesGate: Wasannin katuna masu sauri da annashuwa don ku ƙara sanin juna, wasannin hasashe, zaɓi tsakanin abubuwa biyu, da tambayoyin kuɗi, iyali da makoma.
copy.adventuresBlurb: Labarai ne na bi-da-bi, inda kowane zaɓi ke canza ƙarshen labari.
copy.adventuresGate: Labarun zaɓi-hanya game da ma’aurata. Ku riƙa ɗaukar bi-da-bi wajen yanke shawara: wani lokaci ku kaɗai, wani lokaci a ɓoye tare, wani lokaci kuma tare a fili, ku ga abin da zai biyo baya.

copy.premiumIncludes: Za ku iya gwada guda {{free}} kyauta da kanku. Halal Mode Premium yana buɗe duka {{total}}: bita {{lab}} masu yanayi {{scenarios}}, tambayoyi {{quizzes}} na kowane mataki da labarai {{stories}}. Ku yi wasa da kowane wanda kuka dace, kyauta gare shi/ita.

content.lab-rule-zero.title: Zaɓi da kyau
content.lab-rule-zero.tagline: Ku kalli halayen mutum, ba walƙiyar sha’awa kawai ba, mutumin da za ku gina rayuwa tare.
content.lab-rule-zero.description: Yawancin auren da ke fuskantar matsala an yanke shawara a kansu tun kafin gardama ta farko, lokacin zaɓi. Ku bi yanayi huɗu tare, ku lura da abin da kowannenku ke la’akari da shi da abin da kuke iya mantawa da shi.
content.lab-rule-zero.cover.alt: Kofuna biyu na shayi a kan teburin gidan shayi, da hasken yammacin rana.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-intro.title: Jan hankali ne ke fara dangantaka. Hali ne ke ɗore da ita.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-intro.body: Jin sha’awar wani yana da muhimmanci, yana daga cikin dacewar aure. Amma wannan ji yana raguwa ya dawo lokaci-lokaci, alhali hali, addini, ƙa’idoji da yadda mutum ke fuskantar damuwa suna bayyana kullum. Wannan darasi zai taimaka muku ku kalli dukansu da kyau.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-charm.title: Mutum mai fara’a
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-charm.body: Imran yana da raha, yana da ƙwarin gwiwa kuma magana da shi tana da sauƙi. A ganawarsu uku, ya makara sau biyu, ya yi wa ma’aikacin gidan cin abinci magana da kaushi, kuma ya kan sauya zance duk lokacin da aka ambaci sallah.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-charm.prompt: Yaya kuke fahimtar abin da ya faru?
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-charm.image.alt: Wani mutum mai fara’a yana dariya, ma’aikacin gidan cin abinci kuma bai ji daɗi ba.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-charm.choices.chem: Fahimtar juna ba kasafai ake samu ba, sauran abubuwa za su daidaita bayan aure.
Bayan shekara biyu, yawan makara ya zama ruwan dare, kuma idan ya damu sai ya yi muku magana da kaushi. Sha’awa ba ta canza halinsa ba; ta sa kuka yi wa alamun farko uzuri cikin sauƙi.
Ku tambaye shi kai tsaye game da ma’aikacin da sallah, sannan ku lura da amsarsa.
Wataƙila zai yi dariya ya wuce, ya kare kansa, ko ya yi tunani da gaskiya. Duk abin da ya yi, yanzu kun san yadda yake karɓar tambaya cikin natsuwa, haka zai amsa a cikin aure.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-charm.choices.fami: Bari iyalina su haɗu da shi, su lura da abin da suka gani.
Kawunku ya lura da irin kaushin da kuka gani. Mutanen da ke damuwa da ku kan lura da abin da sha’awa ke rufewa, amma ra’ayinsu ya fi amfani tare da tambayoyinku, ba maimakonsu ba.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-charm.choices.walk: Ku kawo ƙarshensa yanzu, waɗannan alamun haɗari ne.

Wataƙila kun yi daidai. Amma wataƙila kun kawo ƙarshen kyakkyawar dangantaka saboda mako mara kyau, ba tare da tambaya ko ɗaya ba. Samun ƙa’idoji bayyanannu yana da kyau; yanke hukunci ba tare da fahimta ba na iya sa ku rasa mutumin kirki.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-list.title: Jerin buƙatu
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-list.image.alt: Wata budurwa tana sake duba jerin da ta rubuta da hannu.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-list.body: Sana na da jerin buƙatu: dogo, likita ko injiniya, daga al’ummarta, kuma yana zaune a London. Hamza bai cika ko ɗaya ba. Amma yana da haƙuri, kirki, yana sallar akan lokaci, kuma yana magana a sarari game da son samun gida mai natsuwa.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-list.prompt: Me ya kamata Sana ta yi?
Ta tsaya kan jerin. Ta san abin da take so.
Ta jira wasu shekaru uku tana neman wanda ya cika dukkan buƙatun, sai ta gano cewa waɗannan buƙatun ba su nuna ko za su iya zama tare cikin kirki ba.
Ta raba jerin zuwa abubuwan da dole ne su kasance da waɗanda za su yi kyau idan sun kasance, sannan ta sake dubawa.
Addini, kirki da son gida iri ɗaya sun koma kan gaba. Tsayi da matsayin aiki sun koma baya. Ba zato ba tsammani, Hamza ya zama zaɓi mai muhimmanci.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-list.choices.settl: Ta manta da jerin, duk wani Musulmi nagari zai yi.
Yin watsi da duk abin da take so na iya jawo nadama daga baya. Wasu abubuwan cikin jerinta, kamar inda za ta zauna, na iya zama da muhimmanci da gaske. Rarrabe buƙatu ya fi watsar da komai.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-money.title: Tambayar da ba wanda ke yi
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-money.image.alt: Wasu ma’aurata suna duban littafin lissafi tare.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-money.body: Yusuf da Maryam suna jin daɗin fahimtar juna. Babu wanda ya tambayi game da bashi, kashe kuɗi, taimaka wa iyaye ko wanda zai ci gaba da aiki bayan haihuwar yara. Yin maganar kuɗi yana musu kamar zai kashe soyayya.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-money.prompt: Yaushe ya kamata a tattauna waɗannan?
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-money.choices.afte: Bayan ɗaurin aure. Maganar kuɗi yanzu za ta ɓata komai.
Bayan wata uku, Maryam ta gano cewa Yusuf yana aika rabin albashinsa ga iyayensa kuma yana biyan bashin mota. Babu laifi a cikin hakan, amma ganowa yanzu yana sa ta ji kamar an ɓoye mata gaskiya.
Yanzu, cikin mutunci da bayyananniyar magana, kafin ku shaku sosai.

Tattaunawar ta ɗan yi musu nauyi na mintuna goma. Sai suka gano cewa dukkansu suna son tallafa wa iyayensu, suka kuma yarda da yadda za su yi. Wannan ce tattaunawar da ta sa suka ƙara amincewa da juna.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-money.choices.fami: Iyalai sun yarda a kan sadaki da kuɗin biki. Amma ba a taɓa tattauna yadda ake kashe kuɗin yau da kullum, halaye, bashi da abubuwan da suka fi muhimmanci, kuma a nan ne gardama za ta taso.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-stress.title: Ranar da komai ya yi tsauri
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-stress.image.alt: Wani saurayi da ya gaji yana ba wa jami’in tsaron tashar jirgin ƙasa haƙuri.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-stress.body: A doguwar tafiyar jirgin ƙasa da aka samu jinkiri, tare da mai raka ku, kun ga mutumin da kuke tunanin aura a lokacin da haƙurinsa ya ƙare: ya gaji, yana jin yunwa, shirye-shiryensa sun lalace.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-stress.choices.per: Ya kasance cikin natsuwa kwata-kwata. Duk abin da bai kai haka ba gargadi ne.
Babu wanda ke iya kasancewa cikin natsuwa koyaushe. Idan haka kuke sa ran gani, kowane mutum zai iya ba ku kunya, tambayar ita ce yadda yake idan ba ya cikin mafi kyawun halinsa.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-stress.choices.how: Yadda yake mu’amala da mutane idan ya fusata, da ko yana iya dawowa ya gyara al’amari.
Ya yi gunaguni, sannan ya ba jami’in tsaron da ya yi wa kaushi haƙuri, ya kuma mayar da lamarin abin dariya. Wannan gyaran kuskure ne ainihin abin da za ku buƙata a aure.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-stress.choices.ign: Ba komai, kowa yana canzawa a ranar da ta yi masa wuya.
Rayuwar aure tana faruwa ne a ranakun da suka yi wuya. Idan kuka ɗauka ba su da muhimmanci, za ku rasa bayanin gaskiya mafi amfani da za ku samu kafin ɗaurin aure.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-insight.title: Abin da ya kamata a kula da shi
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-insight.body: Jan hankali dalili ne na ci gaba da magana. Waɗannan ne ke taimaka wa aure ya dawwama:
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-insight.points.0: Addinin da kuke tarayya a kai, ba suna kawai da kuka ɗauka ba
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-insight.points.1: Hali a lokacin matsi, yadda ake mu’amala da mutanen da ba za su iya biyan bukatarku ba
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-insight.points.2: Balagar zuciya: ko za ku iya ba da haƙuri, sauraro da gyara kuskure
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-insight.points.3: Ƙa’idoji da tsammani: nauyin ma’aurata, kuɗi, yara, iyali da inda za ku zauna
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-insight.points.4: Ko iyalanku za su iya zama iyali ɗaya
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-talk.prompt: Faɗi abu ɗaya da kowannenku ba zai taɓa sassautawa a kai ba, da kuma abu ɗaya da a dā kuke ganin yana da muhimmanci amma yanzu ba haka ba.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-talk.followUps.0: Wane abu kuka lura cewa kowannenku ya fi ɗauka da muhimmanci a yanayin da kuka tattauna?
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-talk.followUps.1: Wace tambaya ce kuka fi jin tsoron yi wa juna?
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-talk.guide.z-g1.te: Ku tattauna tambayoyin da ba su da armashi tun da wuri: kuɗi, iyali, yara da nauyin ma’aurata.
content.lab-rule-zero.steps.z-talk.guide.z-g2.te: Auna hali da ranakun da suka yi wuya, ba masu sauƙi kaɗai ba.
content.lab-rule-one.title: Kada ku raina ƙananan abubuwa
content.lab-rule-one.tagline: Ƙananan abubuwan da ba a faɗa ba kan taru su zama manyan matsaloli masu wuya a gyarawa.
content.lab-rule-one.description: Bacin rai ba kasafai yake farawa da babban abu ba. Yana taruwa ne daga kwanon da ba a ajiye ba, kalami a lokacin cin abinci, ko shiri da aka sauya ba tare da tambaya ba. Ku yi ƙoƙarin lura da ƙananan abubuwa tun suna ƙanana.
content.lab-rule-one.cover.alt: Kofi ɗaya da aka bari kusa da kwanon wanke-wanke a kicin.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-intro.title: Dutsen ƙanƙani da bango
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-intro.body: Kowane ɗan abin da ya ɓata muku rai da kuka haɗiye kamar ƙaramin dutse ne. Ɗaya ba komai ba ne. Amma ɗari na iya zama bango a hankali, wata rana sai ƙaramin abu ya jawo babban fushi, ku biyun kuma ba ku san dalili ba.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-phone.title: Abincin dare da waya
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-phone.body: Sun yi aure watanni shida da suka wuce. Yawancin maraice, Adam yana duba wayarsa yayin cin abinci. Hakan yana damun Layla, amma tana ganin kamar ƙaramin abu ne da bai cancanci a faɗa ba, yana aiki tuƙuru.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-phone.prompt: Me ya kamata Layla ta yi?
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-phone.image.alt: Miji yana duba waya yayin cin abinci, matarsa kuma tana kallon gefe.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-phone.choices.swall: Ta kyale shi. Bai cancanci gardama ba.
Watanni bayan haka, yana duba waya yayin da take ba shi labarin ranarta, sai ta fashe da fushi. Ya yi mamaki, ba ta taɓa cewa komai ba. A ganinta, abin ya jima yana faruwa tsawon rabin shekara.
Yi masa zolaya mai kaushi cewa ya auri wayarsa ne.
Ya yi dariya amma bai canza ba. Zolaya tana sa ki ji kamar kin faɗi abin da kike so, amma yana iya kasa ganewa, kuma zolayar da ke ɗauke da kaushi kan yi kama da suka.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-phone.choices.say.l: “Ina kewarka a lokacin cin abinci. Za mu iya ajiye wayoyi yayin cin abinci?”
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-phone.choices.say.c: Bai lura ba. Ya amince, wani lokaci yakan manta, sai ta tunasar da shi a hankali. Ƙaramin abu ya tsaya ƙarami.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-mother.title: Wata magana a gidan mahaifiyarsa
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-mother.image.alt: Matar aure matashiya tana murmushin tilas a liyafar iyali.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-mother.body: A gidan mahaifiyarsa, sai ta yi wa girkin Layla zolaya cewa “har yanzu kina buƙatar ƙarin atisaye.” Kowa ya yi dariya. Layla ta yi murmushi. Adam bai lura da wata matsala ba.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-mother.prompt: Daga baya a gida, me ya kamata Layla ta yi?
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-mother.choices.fine: Kada ta ce komai. Zolaya ce fa, kuma mahaifiyarsa ce.
Zolayen suna ci gaba a duk ziyarar. Layla ta fara tsoron zuwan Juma’a, daga baya ta nemi dalilan da za su hana ta zuwa. Adam ya ɗauka ba ta son iyalinsa, hakan kuma ya ɓata masa rai.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-mother.choices.atta: “Mahaifiyarka ta kunyata ni, kai kuma ka zauna shiru.”
Adam ya kare mahaifiyarsa nan take. Yanzu suna gardama ne kan biyayya, ba kan wata magana ɗaya ba, kuma ba a jin ainihin abin da ya ɓata mata rai.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-mother.choices.soft: “Maganar girkin ta ɗan ɓata mini rai. Zan iya gaya maka dalili?”
Adam bai ɗauka da muhimmanci ba. Da ta yi masa bayani cikin natsuwa, sai ya fahimta. Ziyara ta gaba ya ce, “Biryani ɗin Layla ya fi duk wanda na taɓa ci,” mahaifiyarsa kuma ta fahimci saƙon.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-receiver.title: Yanzu ku ne masu sauraro
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-receiver.image.alt: Miji ya juyo ya saurari matarsa yayin da take magana.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-receiver.body: Ma’auratarka ta ce a hankali: “Yana damuna yadda kake yanke shawarar shirin ƙarshen mako ba tare da ka tambaye ni ba.” Ba ka sani ba. Sai ka ji kamar an soka maka suka ba zato ba tsammani.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-receiver.choices.de: “Haka nake yi ne saboda ba ka taɓa ba da shawara ba.”
Ko gaskiya ne ko a’a, yanzu ta koyi cewa idan ta faɗi ƙaramin abin da ke damunta, za a mayar mata da hari. Nan gaba za ta yi shiru, ƙananan duwatsun kuma za su ci gaba da taruwa.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-receiver.choices.th: “Na gode da gaya mini. Me kike so mu yi maimakon haka?”
Ta saki jiki. Kun yarda ku riƙa tsara Asabar tare. Da yake ta iya faɗa cikin sauƙi, za ta ci gaba da gaya muku ƙananan abubuwa, hakan ne zai hana su zama manya.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-receiver.choices.su: “To, ke ki riƙa tsara komai kenan.”
Yana kama da yarda amma ya zama kamar hukunci. Sun samu sauyin, amma sun rasa ɗumi da kusanci. Zai fi musu wuya su sake faɗin ƙananan abubuwa.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-insight.title: Dalilin da ya sa ƙananan abubuwa ke da muhimmanci sosai
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-insight.body: Faɗin ƙaramin abin da ke damunka rabin aikin ne. Sauran rabin shi ne tabbatar da cewa yana da aminci a ji. Ma’auratan da ke samun nasara suna sauƙaƙa faɗin abin da ke damunsu, kuma suna sauraron juna cikin natsuwa.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-insight.points.0: A faɗa cikin kwana ɗaya ko biyu, tun yana ƙarami
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-insight.points.1: Bayanin abin da ya faru da yadda ya ji a rai, ba hukunci kan halin ɗayan ba
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-insight.points.3: Idan an gaya muku wani abu, ku fara da godiya, daga baya ku bayyana ra’ayinku
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-talk.prompt: Wane ƙaramin abu ne zai dame kowannenku idan aka riƙa maimaita shi? Ku faɗa yanzu, tun da yake misali ne kawai.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-talk.followUps.0: Yaya kowannenku zai so a gaya masa idan wani abu ya dame ɗayan?
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-talk.guide.o-g1.tex: Ku faɗi ƙananan matsaloli tun da wuri, kafin su girma.
content.lab-rule-one.steps.o-talk.guide.o-g2.tex: Idan ɗayanmu ya faɗi abin da ke damunsa, ɗayan ya fara da godiya.
content.lab-rule-two.title: Saurara kafin kare kai
content.lab-rule-two.tagline: Fara fahimta. Sannan a bayyana ra’ayi.
content.lab-rule-two.description: Idan wanda kuke so ya ji haushi da ku, zuciyarku za ta so ku yi bayani. Ku gwada abu mafi wuya: ku tambaya, ku saurara kuma ku nuna cewa kun fahimci yadda ya ji kafin ku kare kanku.
content.lab-rule-two.cover.alt: Wani yana magana, ɗayan kuma ya karkata jikinsa don sauraro.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-intro.title: Hirarraki biyu a lokaci guda
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-intro.body: Idan mutum ɗaya ya ji rauni, ɗayan kuma ya fara bayani, hirarraki biyu ke gudana lokaci guda kuma ba a jin ko ɗaya. Sauraro da farko ba yana nufin an sha kashi ba. Haka ake mayar da hirarrakin zuwa hira guda.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-late.title: An sake makara
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-late.body: Zainab ta ce: “Ka ce za ka dawo gida lokacin buɗa baki. Na buɗe baki ni kaɗai, kuma.” Omar ya makale a taron da ba zai iya fita ba.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-late.prompt: Me ya kamata Omar ya fara cewa?
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-late.image.alt: Mace tana zaune ita kaɗai a teburin buɗa baki, mijinta kuma ya iso a makare.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-late.choices.explai: “Taron ya wuce lokaci, babu abin da zan iya yi.”
Gaskiya ne ƙwarai, amma har yanzu tana jin ba a saurare ta ba. Ba ta tambayar ko laifinsa ne; tana gaya masa cewa ta ji kaɗaici. Yanzu sai ta yi gardama kafin a fahimce ta.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-late.choices.ack.la: “Kin buɗe baki ke kaɗai. Wataƙila kaɗaici ya dame ki.”
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-late.choices.ack.co: Kafadunta suka saki. Bayan minti guda ta tambaye shi abin da ya faru, sai ya ba ta labarin taron. Bayanin ɗaya ya sauka dabam bayan an fara sauraron ta.
“Yi haƙuri, yi haƙuri. Ba zai sake faruwa ba.”
Yana kawo ƙarshen hirar da sauri, har ta ji kamar an kawar da ita. Haƙuri ba tare da fahimta ba kan yi kama da son a dakatar da zancen kawai.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-unfair.title: Idan ya yi kamar rashin adalci
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-unfair.image.alt: Mata tana tsayawa ta saurara yayin da mijinta ke magana cikin takaici.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-unfair.body: Ibrahim ya ce: “Kullum kina goyon bayan ’yar’uwarki.” Aisha ta san hakan ba gaskiya ba ne, a makon jiya ta goyi bayansa.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-unfair.prompt: Me ya kamata Aisha ta yi?
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-unfair.choices.corr: Ta tuna masa da makon jiya. “‘Kullum’ ba gaskiya ba ne.”
Ta yi nasara kan kalmar, amma ta rasa damar tattaunawa. Ya tashi yana ganin ba ta iya sauraron sa ko kaɗan.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-unfair.choices.curi: “Me ya faru da ya sa ka ji haka?”
Wani lokaci ne a lokacin cin abincin dare da ta yi dariya da zolayar ’yar’uwarta a kansa. Wannan ya fi sauƙin tattaunawa fiye da “kullum.”
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-unfair.choices.agre: “Ka yi gaskiya, kullum haka nake yi. Yi haƙuri.”
Yarda da abin da ba a gaskata ba na haifar da ɓacin rai a ɓoye, shi kuma ba zai fahimci ainihin abin da ya ɓata rai ba. Nuna fahimta ba yana nufin sallama ra’ayi ba.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-validate.title: Nuna fahimta ba tare da yarda da ra’ayi ba
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-validate.image.alt: Ɗaya daga cikin ma’aurata ya durƙusa don ta’azantar da ɗayan.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-validate.body: Ɗayaninku ya ji haushi domin kun gaya wa iyayenku game da saɓanin da ya shiga tsakaninku. Ku kuma kuna ganin neman shawarar iyayenku ya dace.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-validate.prompt: Wace amsa ce za ta nuna fahimta ba tare da kun bar ra’ayinku ba?
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-validate.choices.ye: “Na fahimci dalilin da ya sa hakan ya zama kamar cin amana, abin ya shafe mu ne. Zan iya bayyana dalilin da ya sa na yi hakan?”
An ji an fahimta, sannan an saurari dalilanku da gaske. Wataƙila har yanzu kuna saɓa wa juna, amma yanzu tare za ku yanke shawarar abin da zai kasance a tsakaninku kawai.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-validate.choices.bu: “Na fahimta, amma iyayena ne kuma ina buƙatar shawara.”
Amma ɗin ya shafe duk abin da aka faɗa kafin shi. Abin da aka ji kawai shi ne kare kai.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-validate.choices.ov: “Wannan ɓacin ran ya wuce gona da iri, ba wani babban abu ba ne.”
Gaya wa mutum yadda ya kamata ya ji shi ne hanya mafi sauri ta ƙara masa bacin rai.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-insight.title: Ku saurara, ku tambaya, ku nuna fahimta, sannan ku yi bayani
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-insight.body: Nuna fahimta yana nufin “wannan ji abin fahimta ne,” ba “ra’ayin ɗayan daidai ne” ba. Za ku iya nuna fahimta ko da ba ku yarda da ra’ayin ɗayan ba.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-insight.points.0: Saurara har ya gama ba tare da shirya amsarka ba
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-insight.points.1: Ku yi tambaya guda don ƙarin fahimta
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-insight.points.2: Ku faɗi abin da kuka ji, da kalmominku
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-insight.points.3: Ku nuna cewa kun fahimci yadda ɗayan ya ji: “Ina ganin dalilin da ya sa hakan ya ɓata rai.”
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-insight.points.4: Sannan ku bayyana naku ɓangaren, a taƙaice
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-talk.prompt: Idan kun ji haushi, me kuke buƙatar fara ji? Kuma wace amsa ce ke ƙara dagula lamarin?
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-talk.followUps.0: A cikin amsoshin nan, wacce ta fi kama da yadda za ku amsa?
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-talk.guide.t-g1.tex: Ku saurara kuma ku nuna fahimta kafin ku yi bayani ko ku kare kanku.
content.lab-rule-two.steps.t-talk.guide.t-g2.tex: Nuna fahimta ba yana nufin yarda ba, za mu iya faɗin duka biyun.
content.lab-rule-three.title: Zagayen mai yawan damuwa da mai gujewa kusanci
content.lab-rule-three.tagline: Ɗaya na neman kusanci, ɗayan na ja da baya, kuma dukkansu suna ƙara jin kaɗaici.
content.lab-rule-three.description: Idan mutum ya ji an yi nisa da shi, yana iya ƙara neman kusanci; idan ɗayan ya ji ana matsa masa, yana iya janyewa. Kowanne mataki na ƙara tsananta na ɗayan. Ku koyi gane wannan zagaye, sannan ku karya shi tare.
content.lab-rule-three.cover.alt: Mutane biyu a kan hanya mai zagaye, ɗaya na miƙa hannu ɗayan kuma na juya baya.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-intro.title: Ba ɗayanku ne matsala ba. Zagayen ne.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-intro.body: Wasu idan suka ji an yi nisa da su sai su matso: saƙonni da tambayoyi da yawa. Wasu idan aka matsa musu sai su ja da baya: su yi shiru, su shagaltu, su buƙaci sarari. Babu wanda ya yi laifi. Amma tare, za su iya makalewa cikin wannan zagaye.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-quiet.title: Ya yi shiru
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-quiet.body: Bilal ya sha wahala a makon nan kuma ya yi shiru na kwana biyu, amsoshinsa kaɗan ne, yana kwanciya da wuri. Safiya na tunanin ko ta yi wani laifi.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-quiet.prompt: Idan ke Safiya ce, me za ki yi?
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-quiet.image.alt: Mace tana duba wayarta, mijinta kuma yana zaune shi kaɗai a wani ɗaki.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-quiet.choices.cha: Ci gaba da tambayar abin da ya faru har sai ya gaya mini.
Kowace tambaya tana sa Bilal ya ji kamar ana matsa masa ya nuna yana lafiya. Sai ya ƙara yin shiru. Shirunsa ya ƙara tsoratar da Safiya, sai ta ƙara tambaya. Zagayen ya fara.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-quiet.choices.mir: Ni ma in yi shiru, idan yana buƙatar sarari, a bar shi.
Yanzu dukansu sun ja da baya, kuma kowannensu yana ɗaukar shirun ɗayan a matsayin ƙin kulawa. Kwanaki suna wucewa, babu wanda ya san yadda zai sake fara magana.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-quiet.choices.nam: “Da alama kin gaji sosai. Ina nan idan kina son magana, babu gaggawa.”
Babu abin da zai sa ya kare kansa. A wannan maraicen, Bilal ya zauna kusa da ita, a hankali ya ba ta labarin aiki.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-space.title: Yanzu kai ne Bilal
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-space.image.alt: Miji da ya gaji yana cikin ɗakin aiki mai duhu, inuwar matarsa kuma tana bakin ƙofa.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-space.body: Ka cika da damuwa kuma kana buƙatar shiru. Safiya ta tambaye ka sau uku yau ko kana lafiya. Kana jin kamar an takura maka.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-space.choices.shu: Ka ce “ina lafiya” sannan ka shiga wani ɗaki.
“Ina lafiya” tare da rufe ƙofa na nuna mata akwai matsala kuma an ware ta. Damuwarta ta ƙaru. Zagayen ya tsananta.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-space.choices.sna: Ta ji kamar kulawarta ta zama maka nauyi. Wataƙila za ta daina tambaya, amma ta fara ajiyar ƙorafi a ranta.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-space.choices.ret: “Aiki ya gajiyar da ni sosai. Ina bukatar in huta yau da dare, za mu iya tattaunawa da kyau gobe bayan sallar asuba?”
Buƙatar sarari tare da faɗin lokacin dawowa ta bambanta ƙwarai da ɓacewa. Ta san abin da ke faruwa da lokacin da za ka dawo. Ita ma za ta iya samun natsuwa.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-loop.title: Gane zagayen a tsakiyar gardama
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-loop.image.alt: Mata na bin mijinta a cikin zaure, shi kuma ya juya baya.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-loop.body: Dukkanku kun makale a ciki: ɗaya na bin ɗayan daga ɗaki zuwa ɗaki yana son a warware matsalar yanzu; ɗayan kuma na cewa “ba zan iya wannan yanzu ba.”
Wanda ya yi daidai ya ci gaba da magana har sai an warware lamarin.
Matsa wa mutumin da ya ja da baya da wuya ya warware komai. Yawanci sai an faɗi abu mafi muni ko kuma an rufe ƙofa da ƙarfi.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-loop.choices.paus: Ɗaya ya ce, “Ina ganin mun shiga wannan zagayen. Mu ɗan dakata na minti talatin, sannan mu dawo.”
Faɗin abin da ke faruwa yana mayar da shi matsalar da za ku warware tare, ba ku da juna ba. Bayan minti talatin, dukkanku kun huce kuma kuna iya sauraron juna da gaske.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-loop.choices.leav: Ɗaya ya fita daga gida don ya huce amma bai faɗi tsawon lokacin ba.
Yin shiru don hucewa na taimakawa; ɓacewa kuwa ba ya taimakawa. Ga wanda aka bari a gida, rashin sanin lokacin dawowar shi ne mafi wuya.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-insight.title: Yadda ake karya zagayen
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-insight.body: Wanda ke neman kusanci yana tambaya, “Komai yana tsakaninmu lafiya?” Wanda ke janyewa kuwa yana tambaya, “Zan iya samun ɗan sarari?” Kowannensu zai iya amsa wa ɗayan:
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-insight.points.0: Mai neman kusanci: a miƙa hannu sau ɗaya cikin fara’a, sannan a ba ɗayan sararin da ya nema
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-insight.points.1: Mai janyewa: a ɗauki sarari, amma a faɗi dalili da lokacin dawowa
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-insight.points.2: Kowannenku zai iya cewa: “Ina ganin mun shiga wannan zagayen”
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-insight.points.3: A dawo a lokacin da aka ce za a dawo, kowane lokaci
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-talk.prompt: Idan abubuwa suka yi tsauri, kuna yawan neman kusanci ne ko janyewa? A wannan lokacin, me zai fi taimaka muku daga ɗayan?
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-talk.followUps.0: Ku amince da wata kalma ko jimla da kowannenku zai yi amfani da ita don cewa “mun shiga wannan zagayen.”
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-talk.guide.h-g2.t: Ku gaya wa juna lokacin da kuke buƙatar sarari da lokacin da za ku dawo.
content.lab-rule-three.steps.h-talk.guide.h-g3.t: Kowannenmu zai iya cewa “mun shiga wannan zagayen,” sai mu dakata na minti talatin.

content.adv-raised-voice.tagline: A gidansa, ihu ba ya nufin komai. A nata kuma, yana nufin komai.
content.adv-raised-voice.description: Adnan ya taso a gida mai hayaniya da ƙauna, inda kowa yake ɗaga murya amma babu wanda yake riƙe da fushi. Huda ta taso a gida mai shiru, inda ɗaga murya yake nufin akwai babbar matsala. Saɓaninsu na farko na gaske bai yi kyau ba. Ku bi su ta ƙofar da aka buga da ƙarfi, neman gafarar da ba ta yi tasiri ba, da tattaunawa game da gidajen da suka taso a cikinsu.
content.adv-raised-voice.themes.2: Iyalin da aka taso a cikinsu
content.adv-raised-voice.cover.alt: Ma'aurata a gefuna dabam na kicin bayan saɓani.
content.adv-raised-voice.roles.A.name: Adnan
content.adv-raised-voice.roles.A.sketch: Mai ɗumi da kirki ne, mai ɗaga murya, da saurin fushi amma da saurin mantawa.
content.adv-raised-voice.roles.B.name: Huda
content.adv-raised-voice.roles.B.sketch: Mai natsuwa ce, mai lura; tana yin tsit sosai idan an ɗaga murya.
content.adv-raised-voice.variables.safety.label: Jin aminci
content.adv-raised-voice.variables.safety.readin: Huda tana jin rashin aminci yayin saɓani.
Dukansu suna jin aminci su saɓa wa juna.
content.adv-raised-voice.variables.understanding: Suna fahimtar abin da ya sa kowannensu yake tunani haka.
content.adv-raised-voice.variables.repair.label: Gyara bayan an ji rauni
content.adv-raised-voice.variables.repair.readin: Ba a gyara raunin da aka jawo ba.
Ana ɗan gyara abin da ya faru.
Suna gyara lamarin da kyau kuma cikin sauri.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.argument.title: Saɓanin
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.argument.image.a: Adnan ya ɗaga murya, Huda kuma ta yi tsit.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.argument.passage: Ya fara ne da makullin mota, sai ya koma kan komai. Muryar Adnan ta ƙara ƙarfi. Faranti ya zame ya karye. Huda ta yi shiru kwata-kwata.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.argument.decisio: Kai ne Adnan. Me za ka yi?
Ka dakata a tsakiyar zance. ‘Ina ɗaga murya. Yi haƙuri. Bari in natsu.’
Adnan ya dakatar da kansa yana ihu, ya nemi gafara.
Ka ci gaba, ba ka gama magana ba, kuma ba ta sa ka yi fushi da ita ba, ko?
Adnan ya ci gaba da ihu.
Ka fice a fusace, ka buga ƙofar da ƙarfi.
Adnan ya fice a fusace, ya buga ƙofar da ƙarfi.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.after.title: Bayan haka
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.after.image.alt: Huda ita kaɗai a gefen gado bayan saɓanin.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.after.passages.0: Huda tana rawa saboda tsoro. A gare ta, ɗaga murya ya kasance alamar wata babbar matsala ce.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.after.passages.1: Har yanzu ƙarar ƙofar da aka buga tana nan a kunnenta.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.after.decision.p: Ke ce Huda. Me za ki yi?
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.after.decision.c: Daga baya, ki gaya wa Adnan: ‘Idan ka yi ihu, ina jin tsoro, ko da ba haka ka nufa ba.’
Huda ta gaya wa Adnan cewa ihu yana tsorata ta.
Kada ki ce komai. Ki yi hattara da shi sosai na tsawon kwanaki.
Huda ta yi shiru, ta riƙa taka-tsantsan na tsawon kwanaki.
Ki kira mahaifiyarki, ki kwana a can.
Huda ta je gidan mahaifiyarta ta kwana.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.apology.title: Neman gafara
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.apology.image.al: Adnan yana miƙa mata furanni, amma ba su yi mata daɗi ba.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.apology.passages: Adnan ya zo neman gafara. A iyalinsa, mutum yana ba da haƙuri, ya rungumi ɗayan, sai a gama.
Tana gidan mahaifiyarta. Dole ne ya je ya ƙwanƙwasa ƙofar iyayenta.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.apology.decision: Me zai faru idan ya nemi gafara?
‘Yi haƙuri da abin da ya faru ɗazu, mun gama ko?’ sannan ya rungume ta.
Adnan ya yi saurin neman gafara, ya kuma yi ƙoƙarin rungumar ta.
‘Yi haƙuri. Za ki iya gaya min yadda kika ji?’
Adnan ya nemi gafara, ya tambaye ta yadda abin ya shafe ta.
Ka yi bayanin cewa ɗaga murya al'ada ce a iyalinka; kada ta ɗauka a kanta.
Adnan ya yi bayanin cewa ihu al'ada ce a iyalinsa.
Ki amince da neman gafararsa domin kawai a kawo ƙarshen batun.
Huda ta amince da gafarar domin kawai ta kawo ƙarshen batun.
Ki bayyana abin da ɗaga murya yake nufi a gidanku.
Huda ta bayyana abin da ɗaga murya yake nufi a gidanta.
Huda ta ce ba ta shirya ba tukuna.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.homes.title: Gidajen da muka taso a cikinsu
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.homes.image.alt: Adnan da Huda suna duba hotunan ƙuruciyarsu tare.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.homes.passages.0: Bayan mako guda, sun tattauna gidajen da kowannensu ya taso a ciki, gidan mai hayaniya da gidan mai shiru.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.homes.lessons.rv: Ku zaɓa tare. Idan kun saɓa, ku tattauna sannan ku sake zaɓa.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.homes.decision.p: A tare: me za ku amince da yi idan kun saɓa?
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.homes.decision.c: Ku kafa alamar dakatawa: kowannenku zai iya cewa ‘mu tsaya kaɗan’, sai ku rabu na minti ashirin, sannan ku dawo ku tattauna.
Sun amince da alamar dakatawa da hutu na minti ashirin.
Kada a taɓa ɗaga murya, ko da batun mene ne.
Sun amince cewa babu ɗaga murya, ko kaɗan.
Ba sai da wani tsari ba, za su ƙara ƙoƙari kawai.
Sun amince kawai su ƙara ƙoƙari.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.second.title: Saɓani na biyu
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.second.image.alt: Adnan ya kama kansa a tsakiyar saɓani.
Bayan wata guda, wani saɓani kuma, game da zaman 'yar'uwarsa na makonni biyu. Adnan ya ji muryarsa na fara ƙaruwa.
Kai ne Adnan. Me za ka yi?
‘Mu tsaya kaɗan.’ Ka je kicin ka yi shayi, sannan ka dawo bayan minti ashirin.
Adnan ya ce su tsaya kaɗan, ya dawo cikin natsuwa.
Ka lura da hakan, sannan ka rage muryarka da gangan.
Adnan ya lura, ya kuma rage muryarsa.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.huda_turn.title: Bangaren Huda
Huda tana magana da ƙarfi a wancan gefen teburin.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.huda_turn.passag: Huda ma tana da nata ɓangaren da za ta yi tunani: a gidansu, mutane sukan yi shiru na kwanaki maimakon ihu.
Ya sake ihu. Ita kuma ta yi shiru na kwanaki uku.
content.adv-raised-voice.scenes.huda_turn.decisi: Ke ce Huda. Me za ki yi?
Ki faɗi abin da kike bukata maimakon ki yi shiru.
Huda ta bayyana abin da take bukata maimakon ta yi shiru.
Ki yi shiru, haka iyalinki suke magance irin wannan batu.
Huda ta yi shiru, kamar yadda iyalinta suka saba yi.
Ki ba da shawarar ku je wurin mai ba da shawara tare.
Huda ta ba da shawarar su je wurin mai ba da shawara tare.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.fight_fair.imag: Adnan da Huda suna murmushi yayin da suke nuna alamar dakatawa.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.fight_fair.what: ‘Mu tsaya kaɗan’ ta zama kalma da iyalinsu ke amfani da ita. Har yanzu suna saɓani, amma babu wanda ke jin tsoro.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.fight_fair.patt: Hanyar saɓani da suka amince da ita
Sun ƙirƙiri wata alama da ta dace da tarihin kowannensu.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.fight_fair.coul: Ba wani abu sosai ba, ko da yake da sun tattauna gidajen ƙuruciyarsu kafin aure.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.fight_fair.take: Duk ma'aurata suna saɓani. Amma waɗanda aurensu ya daɗe sun amince yadda za su yi saɓanin.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.fight_fair.epil: Iyalin Adnan mai hayaniya su ma sun fara cewa ‘mu tsaya kaɗan’.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.fight_fair.guid: Kowannenmu zai iya cewa ‘mu tsaya kaɗan’; mu huta na minti ashirin sannan mu dawo.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.understood.what: Daren da ya tambaye ta ‘yaya abin ya kasance a gare ki?’ ya sauya yadda Adnan yake saɓani.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.understood.patt: Fahimtar abin da ɗayan ya taso da shi
Fahimtar martanin ɗayan a matsayin abin da ya samo daga abubuwan da ya taso da su, ba hari ba, ya sauya komai.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.understood.take: A bayan kowace martani mai zafi akwai gidan da mutum ya taso a ciki.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.understood.guid: Idan ɗayanmu ya yi martani mai ƙarfi, muna tambayar abin da ya haddasa hakan.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.eggshells.title: Tafiya a hankali don kada a tayar da hankali
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.eggshells.image: Huda tana tafiya a hankali a kusa da Adnan.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.eggshells.whatH: Adnan ba kasafai yake ihu yanzu ba. Amma Huda har yanzu tana firgita duk lokacin da ya numfasa da ƙarfi.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.eggshells.patte: Tsoro ba tare da gyara ba
Ihun ya tsaya, amma ba su taɓa tattauna tsoron ba.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.eggshells.could: Da ya nemi gafara tare da tambayar yadda take ji, ba faɗin ‘yi haƙuri’ kawai ba.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.eggshells.takea: Dakatar da halin ba yana nufin an warkar da raunin ba.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.eggshells.guide: Bayan mun ɓata wa juna rai, muna tattaunawa a kai har sai an warware shi.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.repeating.title: Ya sake faruwa
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.repeating.image: Adnan da Huda ba sa magana, suna zaune a gefuna dabam na kujera.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.repeating.whatH: Gardamar da ake ɗaga murya da kuma dogon shiru suna ta musayar wuri. Kowanne yana sa ɗayan ya ƙara muni.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.repeating.patte: Ihun nasa ya sa ta yi shiru; shiru nata kuma ya ƙara masa takaici.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.repeating.could: Alamar dakatawa, da kuma kowannensu ya faɗi yadda ɗabi'arsu take.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.repeating.takea: Muryarsa mai ƙarfi da shiru nata ɓangarori biyu ne na ɗabi'a guda. Ku canza ta tare.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.repeating.guide: Muna faɗin yadda muke saɓani a fili, muna kuma aiki a kai tare.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.counsel.title: Neman taimako
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.counsel.image.a: Adnan da Huda tare da mai ba da shawara.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.counsel.whatHap: Sun fara zuwa wajen mai ba da shawara Musulmi tare. Wannan ita ce shawara mafi kyau da suka yanke a shekarar farko ta aurensu.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.counsel.pattern: Sun ɗauki wannan ɗabi'a a matsayin abin da za su fahimta, ba wani abin kunya ba.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.counsel.couldHa: Babu, neman taimako ƙarfin hali ne.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.counsel.takeawa: Neman taimako da wuri yana nuna irin kulawar da kuke yi.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.counsel.guide.r: Ba mu jin girman kai har ya hana mu neman taimako kan aurenmu.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.papered.title: Rufe matsalar na ɗan lokaci
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.papered.image.a: Adnan da Huda suna murmushi a hoto, firam ɗin hoton kuma ya tsage.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.papered.whatHap: Duk lokacin da abin ya faru, sai ya nemi gafara da sauri ya rungume ta. Yana kamar komai yana lafiya har sai ya sake faruwa.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.papered.pattern: Gyara ba tare da fahimta ba
Gafarar da ta yi sauri ta tsallake matakin fahimtar juna.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.papered.couldHa: Da ya tambaya, ‘yaya abin ya kasance a gare ki?’
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.papered.takeawa: Neman gafara cikin gaggawa yana kawo ƙarshen gardama. Fahimta ce take kawo ƙarshen ɗabi'ar.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.papered.guide.r: Muna tambayar yadda ɗayan ya ji a cikin gafararmu.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.learning.title: Koyon fahimtar juna
Adnan da Huda suna wanke kwanoni tare.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.learning.whatHa: Wasu saɓani suna ƙarewa da kyau fiye da wasu. Suna koyon gane alamun juna.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.learning.patter: Gidajen da suka taso a cikinsu sun koya musu ƙa'idoji dabam-dabam; yanzu suna rubuta nasu.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.learning.couldH: Alamar da suka amince da ita da ta taimaka musu su daidaita da wuri.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.learning.takeaw: Ku biyun kuna shigowa da ƙa'idojin iyalanku cikin aure. Ku rubuta naku tare.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.learning.epilog: Wani lokaci Huda har yanzu tana yin shiru; Adnan ya koyi lura.
Muna rubuta namu ƙa'idojin saɓani, ba na iyayenmu ba.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.quiet_rule.imag: Adnan da Huda suna karatu a falo mai natsuwa.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.quiet_rule.what: Babu ɗaga murya ko kaɗan. Akwai zaman lafiya. Amma wani lokaci Adnan yana jin ba zai iya zama kansa a gida ba.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.quiet_rule.patt: Ƙa'idar ta kare Huda, amma ta sa Adnan ya ɓoye wani ɓangare na kansa na gaskiya.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.quiet_rule.coul: Da sun amince da ƙa'ida da ta dace da su duka, kamar alamar dakatawa.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.quiet_rule.take: Ƙa'ida mai kyau tana kare mutane biyu, ba ɗaya kawai ba.
content.adv-raised-voice.endings.quiet_rule.guid: Ƙa'idojin saɓaninmu dole ne su dace da mu duka.
